reasons.claim: Notification is a regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning), 6.81 ha polygon, Sundsvall, status notified.
Completed felling overlaps only 0.4% of the polygon, so it is not ALREADY_FELLED.

5 eligible species recorded within 250 m, several at 0-11 m: Scapania carinthiaca (EN, 10 records, latest 2023), Hydnellum geogenium (VU), Calypogeia suecica (VU), Scapania apiculata (VU), Lophozia ascendens (VU, latest 2017). All are forest-associated, site-bound, and have felling-relevant threat factors.

Three site-bound forest NT species (Crossocalyx hellerianus, Lophozia guttulata, Chaenotheca gracillima) are also recorded within 250 m, as supporting evidence. Pärluggla (EN, mobile bird, 2026) is also recorded, as supporting evidence only.
Observation effort is adequate (89th county percentile, 213 records within 1000 m, above the county median of 14). The many records therefore reflect real recording activity.

uncertainties: Records show species were recorded, not that they occupy the felling area today. Some records have coordinate uncertainty of 100-167 m against a site equivalent radius of 147 m.
Several records date from 2017; the latest are 2023.
Most records may lie at or beyond the edge of the polygon (distance 0-11 m from the edge); exact positions relative to the stand to be felled are unverified.
not_established: That the species occur within the area to be felled now.
That felling would harm them or cause their decline.
Anything about species hidden or obscured in public data.
Legal protection status (Red List category is extinction risk only).
next_action: Send for human ecological review before felling starts. Check the precise positions of the EN/VU moss and fungus records against the polygon and, if possible, survey the stand in the field.
